description: Zentrale KidMotion Bildwelt. Erst drei Flow-kompatible Cover, dann eine Nutzerwahl. Das gewaehlte Cover wird Szene 01 und danach die EINZIGE Bildreferenz fuer alle weiteren Szenen. Szene 02-28 werden jeweils genau einmal und streng nacheinander erzeugt. Die internen 5er-Bloecke laufen nach der Coverwahl automatisch bis zum fertigen Bilderordner durch. Google Flow erzeugt alle sichtbaren Texte; Remotion zeichnet nur den Countdown-Timer.

promptDefinedUiContract.exerciseTitle: bottom-left; bold uppercase white sans-serif; same font weight and scale every exercise; dark navy semi-transparent rounded rectangle behind text; maximum two lines; no gold plaque, no gray badge, no decorative icon
promptDefinedUiContract.exerciseInstruction: top-right; warm off-white rounded rectangle; dark navy sans-serif sentence; maximum two lines where possible; same size, padding and corner radius every exercise; no speech-tail, no thought-bubble dots
promptDefinedUiContract.getReady: lower-left to lower-center; large bold uppercase white GET READY; directly below it smaller uppercase white NEXT: <EXERCISE>; subtle dark shadow only; same placement and typography for all 11 GET READY scenes
promptDefinedUiContract.introSafetyStartOutro: clean text-only card treatment with the selected character; no tiny human/animal pictograms, no extra mascot figures, no decorative characters that can be confused with a second person
promptDefinedUiContract.timerSafeZone: top-left 230x230 remains free of text, character limbs and important objects on exercise and GET READY scenes
promptDefinedUiContract.rule: This UI contract must be written explicitly into every relevant Google Flow prompt. It is text-only guidance and NEVER authorizes a second image reference.

rules: Workout must feel warm, lovingly directed, playful and age-appropriate: a welcoming HUMAN face with natural expression, cheerful color, sunny soft light and ONE small meaningful game detail. Never sterile, empty, abstract, disturbing or repetitive.
Workout pictures must be visually simple: clear human pose in believable safe training space; no giant robot props, surreal buildings, wild sci-fi clutter or unrelated gimmicks.
Every workout image and cover must show exactly one obviously HUMAN, fully clothed stylized boy or girl, NEVER a robot or animal mascot, even in Robot City.
16:9 landscape, premium stylized 3D family-friendly animation look
exactly one recurring original KidMotion mascot character per episode
cover prompts use a clearly fictional stylized mascot character and stay non-photorealistic
cover prompts must NOT specify an exact age number, skin tone, body type, body measurements or detailed minor physical profile
generate exactly three cover candidates first and wait only for the user's one-time cover choice
the selected cover is renamed Szene 01.png and becomes the SOLE image reference for every later scene
delete the two rejected cover candidates immediately after selection
never use Szene 02, Szene 03, Szene 04, Szene 05 or any other later scene as a reference image
later prompts may describe layout, pose and text in words, but the only attached/reference image is Szene 01.png
repeat the promptDefinedUiContract text explicitly in every relevant scene prompt so Flow cannot improvise a different title/instruction style
generate every non-cover scene Szene 02 through Szene 28 exactly once
generate later scenes strictly one at a time in numeric order; never run two scene generations in parallel
wait for the actual Flow result of the current scene before starting the next scene
after a successful generation save the exact returned image immediately under that scene's exact filename before advancing
if Flow returns an error or no image, leave that scene missing; never copy or reuse a previous scene to fill the slot
never shift later filenames forward when a scene is missing
do not create alternates, variants or regeneration attempts for Szene 02-28
after cover selection generate later scenes in ordered internal batches of maximum five images
batch 1 is Szene 02-06, batch 2 Szene 07-11, batch 3 Szene 12-16, batch 4 Szene 17-21, batch 5 Szene 22-26, final batch Szene 27-28
after cover selection automatically continue from one image batch to the next without asking the user again
do not pause to show or request approval between batches
run scene integrity QA after all scenes: missing files, extra files, exact duplicates and near-duplicates block rendering
deliver the completed image folder only after all required scenes have been generated and named
all final images are named Szene 01.png through Szene 28.png and stored in the same flat image folder
12 exercise scenes must have obviously different silhouettes, body levels and directions; avoid a sequence dominated by squat/lunge/balance variants
the same gym/adventure world may use different zones and modest camera-angle changes while the selected Szene 01 identity remains consistent
dedicated GET READY scenes are Szene 06,08,10,12,14,16,18,20,22,24,26
every GET READY scene shows a neutral ready stance, not the next exercise pose, and contains GET READY plus NEXT: exercise title
ALL visible text except the changing countdown number is generated directly by Google Flow inside the source image
Szene 02 contains complete Intro text; Szene 03 Safety; Szene 04 LET'S BEGIN!
Szene 28 contains GREAT JOB! and WORKOUT COMPLETE
top-left 230x230 px remains clear on exercise and GET READY images for the Remotion timer
there is no Remotion progress bar and no Remotion REST/NEXT text
forbidden: exact numeric age in a cover prompt
detailed minor body description in a cover prompt
photorealistic child imagery in a cover prompt
generating Szene 02 or later before explicit user cover selection
keeping rejected cover candidates after selection
using Szene 05 or any non-cover scene as a reference image
using any second reference image together with Szene 01
generating a second version of Szene 02-28
regenerating Szene 02-28 after a completed image exists
parallel generation of two or more final scenes
starting the next scene before the current Flow request has completed
filling a failed/missing scene by copying a previous output
renaming a later scene into an earlier missing slot
inconsistent exercise title styles such as mixing gold plaques, gray badges and plain white titles
inconsistent instruction bubble size, placement or typography between exercise scenes
tiny human/animal pictograms or extra decorative mascot characters on intro/safety/outro cards
generating more than five later scenes in one internal batch
asking the user to continue between image batches
stopping after a normal image batch before the full scene set is complete
second visible character
extra background people
anatomy errors or hidden/confusing limbs
cropped hands, feet or important joints
pseudo-text
real logos or trademarks
generated countdown timer number
generated progress bar
Remotion title overlays
Remotion instruction overlays
Remotion Intro text
Remotion Safety text
Remotion LET'S BEGIN text
Remotion GET READY text
Remotion NEXT text
Remotion Outro text
thought-bubble dots
motion-dependent exercise poses
reusing the next 20-second exercise image during the 5-second transition
more than two neighboring exercises with near-identical squat/lunge/balance silhouettes
robots, foxes, animals or anthropomorphic objects as workout demonstrators
overly crazy fantasy workout sets, oversized props, chaotic architecture
eerie human expressions, empty sterile CGI sports sets, arbitrary surreal details, emotionally cold or uncanny images

visualComplexityPolicy.workoutBackgrounds: simple gym, safe playground, park or plausible themed training court

kidFriendlyWarmthPolicy.core: Cheerful human athlete with inviting warm expression, soft sunlight, pleasant rich colors and one playful purposeful detail
kidFriendlyWarmthPolicy.never: creepy, cold, sterile, abstract, artificial showroom, meaningless oversized prop or chaotic fantasy
kidFriendlyWarmthPolicy.defaultAgeStyling: family-friendly high-quality 3D; neither babyish nor intimidating
